title: Where Is My Car?
can_do: 找不到熟悉物品时主动询问位置，依据线索缩小寻找范围，并确认找到。
trigger: Child cannot find his red car on the rug; Dad's memory question helps him trace where he last put it.
setting: Looking for a toy car beside a low shelf at home.
essential_props: one red toy car and a blue storage box hiding it on a low shelf

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: You keep looking around. What's missing?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Where's my red car? I had it at story time.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Where did you play with it last?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: On the rug. Then I put it near the shelf.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: It might be behind the blue box.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Let's move the box and see.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: There it is! My red car was under the box.

replay_cards.title: Find the hairbrush
replay_cards.change: The hairbrush is missing from the dresser; Mom remembers leaving it in the bedside basket behind a folded towel.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks where his hairbrush is and asks Mom to help him look. Mom gives the basket clue. He checks behind the towel, finds the same brush, confirms he has it, and starts brushing his hair.

replay_cards.title: Find the red glove
replay_cards.setting: Getting ready by the front door
replay_cards.change: Child needs his red glove. Dad mistakenly points to a blue glove on the bench; the red glove is partly hidden beside a shoe on that same bench.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks where his red glove is. When Dad points to the blue glove, Child corrects him: "Not that one. Mine is red." Dad accepts the correction, looks along the bench and points beside the shoe. Child follows the location clue, picks up his red glove and puts it on.

parent_support: Let him look for something he wants to use, then give one truthful clue to a reachable location.
Wait for his follow-up before moving the obstacle. Ordinary help is a stretch; a repair corrects an actual wrong object, as in the glove card.
